tooltips.sila: Raw, brutal power to affect the environment using one's own body.
tooltips.zrecznosc: Accuracy and control over one's own body — agility, reflex and coordination.
tooltips.kondycja: Limits of physical effort and the body's ability to keep acting despite fatigue.
tooltips.charyzma: Force of personality and the ability to impose one's will, inspire others and earn trust.
tooltips.manipulacja: Ability to understand the emotions and behaviour of others, and to consciously exploit them.
tooltips.opanowanie: Inner calm and the ability to keep control of oneself in situations of fear and chaos.
tooltips.inteligencja: Ability to understand the world's mechanisms and apply knowledge to new situations.
tooltips.spryt: Speed of thought and reaction when time and information are lacking.
tooltips.determinacja: Strength of will, motivation and willingness to sacrifice for a goal.

skillTooltips.snienie: Walking the border of dream and waking — future visions and echoes of memory.

about.title: About
about.description: ZombieSheet is a web-based character sheet for post-apocalyptic tabletop RPG sessions. Create games, invite players, and keep hero stats, inventory, and roll history in one place.
